snippet.title: Soccerverse | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Soccerverse is LIVE! 

Welcome to Soccerverse, the massively multiplayer online football sim where you call the shots. 

Step into an immersive sporting universe where real-life football influences your in-game decisions. Manage a team, scout emerging talent, and shape the future of your club as you build a footballing empire with friends.

Play for free now, anytime, anywhere: https://play.soccerverse.com/ 

Find out more: https://soccerverse.com/ 

Follow #Soccerverse for more information: 
• X / (Formerly Twitter): / @Soccerverse 
• Discord: / @Soccerverse 
• Facebook: / @Soccerverse 
• Tik Tok: / @PlaySoccerverse
